depiction.composition: single glyph crossed out by a diagonal bar from top-left to bottom-right

readings.meaning: Route disabled / no route / directions unavailable
Location tracking or trip path turned off

ambiguity: Heavily sliced by the diagonal bar so the left pin and path look like a pair of scissors handles or a stylized letter R next to a map pin.

reasoning: The diagonal slash cuts directly through the middle of the route-and-pins glyph, obliterating the connecting path and leaving two disconnected shapes that resemble a half-scissor and a map pin. Because it is nearly unreadable at a glance and represents an uncommon negative UI state ('route disabled'), it should be discarded.
